下午，距离校门口不远处的小菜馆。

这家店是上戏学子的宝藏餐馆，因为其价格实惠，分量足，他们这些表演系的学生没事就喜欢来这聚餐。

跟老板娘打了个招呼，魏沐来到二楼包厢。

推开门，三个女人睁着大眼睛看着他。

“不好意思，来晚了。”

“没事，我们才到不久，快坐快坐。”

李金铭主动站起来招呼，她和魏沐关系不错，这妹子性格有点像《爱情公寓》里的陈美嘉，不过没有美嘉那样模糊和脆弱。

性格温婉的赵霁随口问道：“听说你去了一趟京城？”

“对，我去那边有点事。”

一直没有说话的海陆终于忍不住，她直截了当的说：“魏沐，你也看到了，我们这次是背着晓晨来的。你们真的不能重归于好？”

她们三个都是王晓晨的好闺蜜，经常在一起玩。

因为王晓晨，魏沐和她们关系比较好，没事的时候给她们买吃的喝的，而她们则经常在王晓晨面前美言几句。

所以，魏沐来之前就知道她们要干什么。

“你们都听了我那首歌吧？我想我说的很明白。”

“怎么会这样？你们为什么要走到这一步。”

海陆还是不愿相信，她和王晓晨同一时间入学，又看着魏沐追她，两人在一起，最后分手。

四年时间，一晃而过，就像梦一样。

“行啦，大家都是同学，我们应该尊重他们的想法。”

赵霁看的很开，晓晨虽然没有跟她们解释分手原因，但赵霁隐约能猜出来提分手的是她。

“对，分手了还可以做朋友嘛，我们毕竟是同学，以后同学聚会都要来的。”，李金铭大大咧咧劝道。

察觉到气氛有些尴尬，赵霁赶紧转移话题：“魏沐，你现在可是我们学校的大红人，我今天还看到学校门口围了好几个女生，都想来见你。”

“她们只是心血来潮，待几天就回去了。”

“那也很厉害，我们班有粉丝的就你一个。”

“对了，没有经纪公司找你吗？”

“有，但是我还想再等等看。”

这话让三个女生羡慕不已。

别看上戏是三大院校之一，但她们这些毕业生有多少能签约经纪公司？

到目前为止，也就王晓晨被陆毅学长的公司签下，其他人只能跑单帮。

现在娱乐圈的竞争太激烈，毕业生除非你非常出色，否则只能从跑剧组开始。

海陆幽幽来了一句:“还是你有本事。”

她前两年拍了一些戏，也积累了观众缘，可临到毕业，还是没有经纪公司签约。

魏沐知道海陆，三年后在《新还珠格格》里面出演紫薇，搭档李佳航（饰演尔康）

巧合的是，这俩人都是上戏毕业，一个04级，一个06级。

In the afternoon, there was a small restaurant not far from the school gate.

This restaurant is a treasure restaurant for theater students. Because of its affordable prices and generous portions, acting students like them like to come here to have dinner together when they have nothing to do.

After saying hello to the proprietress, Wei Mu came to the private room on the second floor.

Opening the door, three women looked at him with wide eyes.

"Sorry, I'm late."

"It's okay. We've just arrived. Sit down quickly."

Li Jinming took the initiative to stand up and greet her. She had a good relationship with Wei Mu. This girl's personality was a bit like Chen Meijia in "Love Apartment", but not as vague and fragile as Meijia.

Zhao Ji, who has a gentle personality, asked casually: "I heard that you went to the capital?"

"Yes, I have something to do over there."

Hailu, who had been silent all this time, finally couldn't help it. She said bluntly: "Wei Mu, you also saw that we came here behind Xiaochen's back this time. You really can't get back together?"

The three of them are Wang Xiaochen's best friends and often play together.

Because Wang Xiaochen and Wei Mu have a better relationship with them, they buy them food and drink when they have nothing to do, and they often say nice words in front of Wang Xiaochen.

Therefore, Wei Mu knew what they were going to do before he came.

"You all listened to my song, right? I think I made it clear."

"How could this happen? Why have you come to this point?"

Hailu still didn't want to believe that she and Wang Xiaochen entered school at the same time, and watched Wei Mu chase her. The two got together and finally broke up.

Four years passed by in a flash, like a dream.

"Okay, we are all classmates, we should respect their ideas."

Zhao Ji was very open-minded. Although Xiaochen did not explain the reason for the breakup to them, Zhao Ji could vaguely guess that she was the one who proposed the breakup.

"Yes, we can still be friends after breaking up. We are classmates after all, and we will come to class reunions in the future." Li Jinming persuaded him carelessly.

Sensing that the atmosphere was a bit awkward, Zhao Ji quickly changed the subject: "Wei Mu, you are now a famous person in our school. I saw several girls gathered around the school gate today, and they all want to come and see you."

"They just stayed there for a few days on a whim and then went back."

"That's pretty cool too. You're the only one in our class who has a fan."

"By the way, no agency is looking for you?"

"Yes, but I want to wait and see."

These words made the three girls envious.

Although the theater is one of the three major universities, how many of their graduates can sign with a brokerage company?

So far, only Wang Xiaochen has been signed by senior Lu Yi's company, and the others can only work as a single gang.

The competition in the entertainment industry is too fierce now. Unless you are a very good graduate, you can only start by working on the crew.

Hailu said quietly: "You still have the ability."

She filmed some movies in the past two years and gained popularity among the audience, but when she graduated, she still didn't have a contract with an agency.

Wei Mu knew Hailu, and three years later he played Ziwei in "The Return of the Princess", partnering Li Jiahang (playing Er Kang)

Coincidentally, both of them graduated from theater, one with grade 04 and the other with grade 06.
